legal_ref: GCC Unified VAT Agreement (signed, not implemented domestically); no VAT law enacted
quote: Value Added Tax (VAT) in Qatar: Qatar has not applied the Value Added Tax (VAT). (GTA Investors Guide, FAQ 'Types of Taxes in the State of Qatar')
source_title: General Tax Authority (Qatar) – Investors Guide / FAQ on Taxes in Qatar for Foreign Investors
notes: Qatar signed the GCC Unified VAT Agreement (which provides for a 5% standard rate; the GTA 'Laws and Regulations' page reproduces it) but has not enacted a domestic VAT law. GTA lists the taxes in force as income tax (10%; 35% oil & petrochemicals), withholding tax, capital gains tax, global minimum tax, and Excise Tax (Law No. 25 of 2018, in force 1 Jan 2019: 100% on tobacco, energy drinks, special-purpose goods, 50% on carbonated drinks; sweetened drinks moved to a tiered volumetric model from 6 July 2026). No general sales tax.
